content.comment_body: Hello everyone, is it possible to implement this type of application with [product_name]? Looking forward to your responses. Thank you.

Hello, you should be able to find the required settings in the up/down counter parameters under the special function list. There are two thresholds available to choose from. For more details, refer to section 4.4.15 of [document]: [url]. Best regards, [user_name]
Thank you for your quick reply. I will try this solution.

Hello, if you want to compare two counter values, you can use an Analog Math block to convert the counter value to an analog value, then utilize the Analog Comparator. Refer to the attached image for clarification. Regards,
